# Womanhood of Wubz

> Handmade hats and accessories for bass music fans, made in Denver, Colorado. Bringing you the accessories that celebrate the magic of good music and the power of connection.

The site is a single page. Every designed hat is listed in the product grid, each with a name, a style, a price, and a sold-out flag.

## Pages

- [Home](https://womanhoodofwubz.neocities.org/): the full product grid, plus contact links and a SoundCloud mix player.
- [Sitemap](https://womanhoodofwubz.neocities.org/sitemap.xml): canonical URL list.

## Elsewhere

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/womanhoodofwubz/): new drops and custom work.
- [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/marisa-kerstanski): mixes by the artist behind the brand.
